name: Every journal line is strictly one-sided (debit or credit) with a matching signed core.LedgerEffect amount

payload.rationale: A journal line must carry a strictly positive amount on exactly one side (debit or credit), zero on the opposite side, and match core.LedgerEffect sign convention (+debit, -credit).

response.expression: (self.side == "debit" and self.debit_amount > 0 and self.credit_amount == 0 and self.amount == self.debit_amount) or (self.side == "credit" and self.credit_amount > 0 and self.debit_amount == 0 and self.amount == -self.credit_amount)

payload.subject: accounting.JournalLine
